laws.rule: Sustainable tourism tax (ITS), per person per day, plus 10% VAT. From 1 May to 31 October: EUR 4 at five-star and four-star-superior hotels, EUR 3 at four-star and three-star-superior, EUR 2 at most other hotels and holiday rentals, EUR 1 at hostels and campsites. It is 75% lower from November to April. Under-16s are exempt, and nights from the 9th on are half price.
laws.heading: Govern de les Illes Balears, Ley 2/2016

laws.rule: In set streets of four tourist areas (Platja de Palma and s'Arenal de Llucmajor, Magaluf, and the West End of Sant Antoni de Portmany in Ibiza), drinking alcohol in public spaces is banned; bars, restaurants and nightclubs may serve it. Shops there can't sell alcohol from 9.30 pm to 8 am. Fines for drinking in public range from EUR 500 to EUR 1,500 (about A$795 to A$2,384 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293). The streets are shown on the Balearic Government's map.
laws.penalty_signal: EUR 500 to EUR 1,500 for drinking in public (about A$795 to A$2,384)
laws.heading: Govern de les Illes Balears, Decree-law 1/2020 as amended by Decree-law 2/2024 (responsible tourism)

laws.rule: Activities that endanger people's safety are banned, such as balconing: jumping from balconies or windows, or climbing between balconies or windows. In the four listed tourist areas, party boats may not come within one nautical mile of the coast or pick up and drop off passengers there, and drink offers such as happy hours, open bars and 2-for-1 deals are restricted. All-inclusive establishments may serve no more than three alcoholic drinks per person per service.

sites.name: Talayotic Menorca: Naveta des Tudons and Torre d'en Galmés
sites.era: Talayotic, Bronze Age to Iron Age
sites.what: Prehistoric monuments of Menorca (UNESCO World Heritage, 2023); the island council runs these two sites.

access.opening: 2026 timetable (the sheet gives no season dates): Naveta des Tudons Tuesday to Saturday 9 am to 8.15 pm, Sunday 9 am to 3.15 pm; Torre d'en Galmés Tuesday to Saturday 9 am to 8.30 pm, Sunday 9 am to 3.30 pm; both free entry on Mondays.
access.tickets: Naveta des Tudons EUR 2 (about AUD 3, RBA rate 30 October 2026); Torre d'en Galmés EUR 3 (about AUD 5, RBA rate 30 October 2026). Free for under 8s, on Mondays and for tourist guides.

events.what: Spanish municipal elections (all town and city councils) and elections to this community's regional parliament, Sunday 23 May 2027: the law sets them for the fourth Sunday of May every four years, unless a regional president with the power to dissolve calls an earlier election.
events.effect: Election day; a day of reflection beforehand. Not yet formally called: the call is issued by decree about 54 days before.
